decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic yogurt line that is very close to the firm’s core organic dairy capabilities, has remained on the website across two years, and fits a firm with its own R&D and broad related knowledge, it is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

Mild sliced cheese builds directly on the firm’s established cheesemaking know-how and customer base, so under strong absorptive capacity the firm is more likely to refine and retain it than to exit after an initial year.

Sliced butter cheese is also closely related to the firm’s existing dairy and cheese competences, and with in-house R&D in a growing market the firm is likely to keep it on the market while learning from early sales.
